# ledger_object_organisation (Data Source)

What is assigned to one object: its category, its labels, the labels the person removed and its buckets. Read-only, whatever the origin of each assignment (the person, a rule or a model). Use `ledger_category_assignment`, `ledger_label_assignment` and `ledger_bucket_member` to manage the person's own assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everything assigned to one commitment, whoever assigned it (the person, a rule or a model).
data "ledger_object_organisation" "rent" {
  object_type = "commitment"
  object_id   = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA"
}

output "rent_category_origin" {
  value = data.ledger_object_organisation.rent.category_origin
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_id` (String) The Ledger identifier of the object.
- `object_type` (String) The kind of object: `transaction`, `commitment`, `account` or `merchant`. A merchant is addressed by its record identifier (`ledger_merchant`) and needs an API token with the administrator-only `merchants:read` and `merchants:write` grants, because merchant names derive from bank text; an archived merchant takes no new assignment. Buckets never hold merchants. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `bucket_ids` (Set of String) Identifiers of the buckets the object is in (commitments and accounts only).
- `category_id` (String) The category's identifier; null when the object has no category, or when the person chose none (see `category_none`).
- `category_none` (Boolean) True when the person explicitly chose no category.
- `category_origin` (String) Who set the category: `user`, `rule` or `model`; null when no category decision exists.
- `label_ids` (Set of String) Identifiers of the labels on the object.
- `removed_label_ids` (Set of String) Identifiers of the labels the person took off; rules and models do not add them back.
